messages:
PagerDuty: ALERT: High 5xx rate and token backlog on /v1/embeddings (us-west1). Error spike started ~4100001200. Affected: embeddings-heavy customers + downstream chat latency. Incident INC-20260317-47. Paging oncall.

Ava: I'm on it, pinged SRE. First look at dashboards.

Marcus: starting triage. seeing sustained qps spike to embeddings route, queue depth growing, KV cache pressure high. Chat throughput slightly degraded due to shared worker pools.

Ava: quick mitigation idea: carve embeddings route capacity, throttle non-paid embeddings, bump chat priority. Can we do per-endpoint quota changes live?

Kai: yes we have admin route control. I can apply route-level qps caps and token caps for embeddings namespace. Will do incremental to avoid client churn.

Ava: plan: 1) Reduce embeddings global soft quota to 35% of baseline for 10min. 2) Raise chat route priority and allow burst tokens for premium tenants. 3) Disable live rerank feature for free tier and background rerank jobs. 4) Notify support for customer-impacted list.

Marcus: confirm logs show majority of new traffic is embeddings bulk-ingest from two external customers (C1, C2). Those accounts show retry storms. Recommend immediate per-tenant throttles as well.

Kai: applying soft quota to /routes/embeddings -- executing internal command:
```
rd-admin route update --route embeddings --soft-qps 120 --soft-tokens 5000 --apply 10m
```

DeployBot: JOB 9876: route config change queued and applied by Kai at 4100001302. Change propagated to edge nodes in 45s.

Ava: applying tenant-level throttle for C1 and C2 to 20 rps each, and enabling 429-exponential-backoff enforcement.

Kai: tenant throttle commands:
```
rd-admin tenant throttle --id C1 --rps 20 --enforce 429
rd-admin tenant throttle --id C2 --rps 20 --enforce 429
```

DeployBot: Tenant throttle applied for C1,C2 at 4100001320.

Marcus: after throttles, queue depth starting to drop, avg embeddings latency down 60% within 90s. Chat latency returning to normal for premium routes. Non-premium chat still intermittent.

Priya: support here — pulling list of affected customers and crafting templated message. Any severity customers we should fast-track notifications for?

Ava: mark C1 as P1 (ongoing data ingest job), C3 had errors but transient. Priya, send targeted heads-up to any customers with >5% error rate in last 15m. Use "embeddings degraded" subject.

Lina: product — can we disable rerank for free-tier now? That should reduce CPU on rerank workers.

Kai: toggling feature-flag: `ff-toggle rerank_free_tier off`

DeployBot: Feature flag `rerank_free_tier` turned OFF at 4100001355. Impact: rerank calls return cached baseline or 204 for free tier.

Marcus: perf graphs look cleaner. Embeddings throughput back to sustainable zone. Still seeing small retry waves from batch clients; will keep throttles until pattern stabilizes.

Ava: customer impact assessment (quick): 14 customers saw >5% errors, 3 customers (C1,C2,C4) saw ingestion stalls, chat P95 latency increased 200ms for standard tier for ~10min. No full region outage.

Priya: prepping outreach: support will email affected accounts and open tickets for C1/C2 priority.

Ava: oncall handoff in 25m to Marcus. Summary for handoff: what changed, why, and next steps — leave throttles active until we validate client backoff.

Marcus: taking handoff early here. I'll keep monitoring for 2h, will coordinate with infra to identify root cause (client-side retry pattern + bulk ingestion). Next actions: reach out to C1/C2 ops to ask them to stagger ingest, follow up on cache pressure logic.

Ava: thanks team. Incident remains open -> INC-20260317-47. I'll add notes + timeline to incident doc and brief SOC.

DeployBot: Incident INC-20260317-47: mitigation actions recorded.

Ava: handoff complete. Leaving throttles and FF changes in place. If anything regresses alert me immediately. :thumbsup:

Marcus: acknowledged, will update incident doc when we close.
